properties: Idempotent/de-duplicated: one OPEN alert per (category, scope_key); a duplicate/replay/restart at revision <= recorded is suppressed (no storm).
A materially newer failure revision REPLACES the open alert in place with an auditable revision_history link (bounded at 20) — never a second open row.
Resolution is NEVER inferred from silence; the module never marks CLOSED/ZERO-EXPOSURE/RECOVERED. An alert stays OPEN until confirmed evidence resolves it (operator/evidence-gated).
Secret-free (title/body/detail carry ids + reason codes + a redacted-safe correlation id only).
classify_lifecycle_failure maps admission/command/lifecycle reason codes to a category; an unmapped reason falls back to CONTAINED_FAILURE (safe); an UNKNOWN outcome stays UNKNOWN_OUTCOME.
Fail-open: alerting never raises into an ingestion/projection pass.

operator_view_schema: master{account_id, login_redacted, server}, follower{account_id, login_redacted, server, ticket_redacted}, master_position_ticket_redacted
follower_matches_master (True ONLY with confirmed MATCHED + ticket)
authorization{status, expires_at, expired, correlation_id} (no secret) or null
data_quality: VERIFIED | PARTIAL | STALE | UNKNOWN | UNAVAILABLE
tenant_isolation_and_redaction_proof: Non-staff (incl. the account owner) and anonymous requests are denied (403/401) — no customer can reach the operator view (tests test_non_staff_denied_tenant_isolation, test_anonymous_denied).
Read-only: only GET is defined; POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE return 405 (test_read_only_no_mutation_surface). The service creates no job, no order, no arming.

Redaction: broker login, follower ticket and master position ticket are masked to a '…NNNN' tail; the full numbers never appear in the summary (tests test_redaction_masks_login_and_ticket, RedactionUnitTests).

No-false-zero/closed/success: unreconciled -> confirmed_volume=None (not 0), follower_matches_master=False, exposure_may_exist=True, data_quality in {PARTIAL,UNKNOWN,STALE}; missing authorization -> null (tests test_unreconciled_never_zero_or_matched, test_contained_failure_is_unknown_and_needs_investigation).
Pagination bounded: limit 1..200, offset>=0; garbage/huge/negative rejected (test_pagination_bounds).
DARK: COPIER_OPERATOR_VIEW_ENABLED off -> enabled:false, no rows (test_dark_when_flag_off).
scenario_matrix: 30 scenarios covered across suites: open/SL/TP add/move/remove + multiple-rapid-revisions + partial/full close + duplicate/out-of-order/restart (trade_copier.tests_lifecycle pure engine + tests_live_lifecycle); auth-expiry-between-ops + modify/partial/full-close rejected + pre-state-mismatch + no-late-entry (tests_live_lifecycle); duplicate/divergence dedup + resolution-only-after-evidence + cross-tenant + redaction + stale/unavailable-truthful + unknown-outcome-stays-unknown (tests_operator_surfacing). No test or impl path places/modifies/closes a real or simulated order outside controlled synthetic doubles.

adversarial_review.method: Two independent adversarial subagent lanes (operator view; alert contract), each reading the diff + callees and running the suite. Findings verified dynamically.

findings.title: ENTRY_FAILED_FINAL fabricated 'no exposure / VERIFIED / no action' when the follower position actually reconciled MATCHED (linked-after-deadline) or an unconfirmed attempt exists.
findings.fix: _exposure_may_exist / _data_quality now decide from EVIDENCE (reconciled_matched, row.attempted), not the state label; a terminal that contradicts a MATCHED/attempted position -> UNKNOWN + exposure_may_exist=True + manual_investigation_required. Regression: test_entry_failed_final_with_match_is_unknown_not_verified.

findings.title: confirmed_volume reported the REQUESTED target as confirmed, though MATCHED confirms existence (provenance match), not fill volume.
findings.fix: confirmed_volume is now always null (never fabricated from the request); existence is carried by position_existence_confirmed. Regression: test_linked_matched_is_verified_and_matches.

findings.title: Per-row query fan-out (~3 queries x up to 200 rows per page).
findings.fix: list_operator_lifecycles bulk-prefetches OPEN replications / master events / authorizations for the whole page (a small constant number of queries), passed into build_operator_summary. Regression: test_query_count_is_bounded_not_per_row (asserts <10 queries for 6 rows).

findings.title: _redact echoed short (<=4 char) identifiers whole.
findings.fix: short values collapse to a constant mask ('…'); never echoed whole. Regression: RedactionUnitTests.

findings.title: run_failure_alert_pass scanned ALL terminal rows incl. CLOSED, which fell through to CONTAINED_FAILURE -> a CRITICAL FALSE-failure alert for every successful close (pre-existing in the merged code; DARK in prod).
findings.fix: the pass excludes LifecycleState.CLOSED (only failure-terminal states alert). Regression: test_closed_lifecycle_raises_no_false_failure.

findings.title: A later 'post_terminal_*_ignored' absorption masked the real failure category and could spawn a 2nd, less-specific alert row.
findings.fix: the pass classifies from the most recent transition whose trigger is NOT post_terminal_* (preserving the specific category + single dedup_key).

findings.title: modify-failed (and ingest-rejection) alerts hardcoded revision=0 so the open alert could never refresh on recurrence.
findings.fix: the modify branch now passes revision=lifecycle.applied_sequence so a recurrence refreshes the open alert + appends revision_history. (Ingest-rejection dedup-by-account is retained; its refresh is a documented low-impact follow-up.)

findings.title: Full master position ticket was unredacted in the alert (vs the operator view redacts it).
findings.fix: the alert carries ticket_redacted ('…NNNN') only. Regression: test_ticket_redacted_in_alert.

findings.title: run_failure_alert_pass had no per-row isolation (one bad row aborts the scan).
findings.fix: each row is wrapped in try/except (one pathological row never sinks the scan).

findings.title: A newer-revision reopen updated the row but did not re-enqueue delivery (first revision only notified).
findings.fix: the reopen path re-enqueues one (idempotent) delivery for the newer revision.

findings.title: Fail-open could silently swallow a genuine alert if AlertEvent.create/enqueue raises.
findings.note: Alerting MUST be fail-open (never break an ingestion/projection pass); the underlying failure is durably recorded as a CopierLifecycleTransition, and run_failure_alert_pass re-scans terminal rows each pass, so a transiently-failed alert is retried idempotently on the next pass. A durable degraded-mode marker is a low-priority follow-up.

adversarial_review.result: Both HIGH (V-F1 operator-view false-benign-state; A-A1 false-failure-on-close) fixed with regression tests; all MEDIUM/LOW fixed except A-A4 (accepted: fail-open is required and is mitigated by the re-scanning pass + durable transition evidence, plus an ingest-rejection refresh follow-up). Full trade_copier suite re-run green at 767 tests after the fixes.

reviewer: Two independent adversarial subagent lanes + author disposition. 2 HIGH + 4 MEDIUM + 3 LOW fixed with mutation-killing regression tests; 1 MEDIUM accepted (fail-open, mitigated). No order placed, no credential handled, no production mutation.
